title: Checkpoint runner: osf verify now drives moon tasks
summary: This change replaces the in-process `osf verify` gate with a checkpoint runner. `osf verify --checkpoint <name>` now selects the moon tasks tagged for that checkpoint, runs them over the affected file list, and journals one hash-chained verification event per task plus a checkpoint-complete event. Each check is exposed standalone as `osf check <name>` so a moon task can run it over an explicit file list, and the file list reaches the task through `OSF_FILES_FROM` with `OSF_FILES_HASH`/`OSF_INDEX_HASH`/`OSF_COMMITS_HASH` as cache keys. Supporting pieces: a moon adapter that parses run reports and query output, a journal with replay-stable hashing, git environment scrubbing so a caller's `GIT_DIR` cannot redirect a call, `osf hooks install` for plain shells, and a `hook post-tool` checkpoint for coding agents.

nodes.label: Git hooks
nodes.subtitle: pre-commit, pre-push, commit-msg
nodes.summary: The devcontainer hooks now call `osf verify --checkpoint pre-commit` and `--checkpoint pre-push` instead of the old `--stage` form. `osf hooks install` writes equivalent scripts to a folder outside the repository and points `core.hooksPath` at it.

nodes.label: CI checkpoint job
nodes.subtitle: pull_request only
nodes.summary: A new GitHub Actions job builds osf, installs moon, fetches the base ref, and runs `osf verify --checkpoint pull-request --base origin/<base>`, uploading the journal buffer and `.osf/out` as evidence.

nodes.label: Agent post-tool hook
nodes.subtitle: osf hook post-tool
nodes.summary: A coding agent's PostToolUse event names a written file; the hook resolves it to a repository-relative path and runs the hook checkpoint on it, refusing the write on an error finding.

nodes.label: osf verify
nodes.subtitle: --checkpoint <name>
nodes.summary: The single entry point every gate calls. It detects adoption, resolves the checkpoint's base and file list, takes the moon report lock, clears stale SARIF, runs the tagged moon targets, and journals the result.

nodes.label: osf check <name>
nodes.subtitle: scan, scan-staged, lint-writing, lint-skill, scan-commits
nodes.summary: One check from the old verify gate, callable on its own over an explicit file list. Reads files from arguments, else `OSF_FILES_FROM`, and writes SARIF to `--sarif-out`.

nodes.label: moon adapter
nodes.subtitle: moon.rs
nodes.summary: Runs `moon run <targets> --affected --stdin`, parses `runReport.json` into per-task outcomes, reads `moon query tasks` for tag membership and slots, and holds the report lock that serialises concurrent runs.

nodes.label: Journal
nodes.subtitle: hash-chained JSONL
nodes.summary: Appends one verification event per task plus a checkpoint-complete event to `<state_dir>/buffer/<run>.jsonl`. The event hash excludes wall-clock time, duration and cache state, so two runs with identical decisions share a head hash.

nodes.label: git layer
nodes.subtitle: scrub_git_env_for_dir
nodes.summary: Every git call now removes inherited repository-locating `GIT_*` variables, keeps `GIT_INDEX_FILE` only when it lies inside the target's own git directory, and forces `LC_ALL=C`. Adds `upstream_ref`, `commits_since`, `staged_blob_hash`, `files_at` and local config read/write.

nodes.label: Skill and agnix lints
nodes.subtitle: lint_skill_text, lint_text
nodes.summary: Both lints now take already-resolved content instead of reading from disk, so a checkpoint can lint the committed `SKILL.md` and scripts rather than whatever the working tree holds.

nodes.label: moon workspace config
nodes.subtitle: .moon/workspace.yml
nodes.summary: Declares the `osf` project at `.osf` and the git VCS client with `main` as the default branch.

nodes.label: osf moon tasks
nodes.subtitle: .osf/moon.yml
nodes.summary: One task per check per checkpoint, tagged `osf-hook`, `osf-pre-commit`, `osf-pre-push` or `osf-pull-request`, plus `fmt`, `clippy`, `test` and `test-nested`. Each declares `$OSF_FILES_HASH` and, where relevant, `$OSF_INDEX_HASH` or `$OSF_COMMITS_HASH` as inputs, and its SARIF path as an output.

nodes.label: moon CLI
nodes.subtitle: pinned 2.5.5
nodes.summary: Installed by checksum in the devcontainer and by a new composite action in CI. osf requires at least 2.3 and strips inherited `MOON_*` variables before every call.

nodes.label: Journal buffer
nodes.subtitle: <state_dir>/buffer/*.jsonl
nodes.summary: One file per run, each its own hash chain from genesis. Opening a run id that already has events is refused rather than resumed.

nodes.label: SARIF output
nodes.subtitle: .osf/out/<task>.sarif
nodes.summary: Each check task writes its findings as SARIF 2.1.0. The runner deletes these before moon runs so a stale file is never read as this run's result, and reads them back while still holding the report lock.

nodes.label: moon cache and report
nodes.subtitle: .moon/cache/
nodes.summary: moon's own run report and task logs, plus the `osf-run-report.lock` file that serialises concurrent checkpoint runs on one workspace.

edges.summary: The runner no longer runs checks in process; it hands the checkpoint's tag to the moon adapter, which is the only path to a check now.

edges.label: moon run :#<tag> --affected --stdin
edges.summary: The affected file list goes in on stdin; moon selects the tagged tasks and runs them.

flows.title: A pre-push checkpoint run
flows.summary: From the hook to the journal: resolve the pushed-to ref, select the changed files, run the tagged moon tasks over them, and record one event per task.

messages.label: resolve base via upstream_ref, select changed files
messages.note: With no remote ref at all, the base is the empty tree, so a first push checks everything it sends.

messages.label: osf check scan --checkpoint pre-push
messages.note: One invocation per tagged task; the file list reaches each through OSF_FILES_FROM.

messages.label: one verification event per task, then checkpoint-complete
